prompt: Journal this session. We fixed a flaky login test in tests/auth_test.py caused by a race condition in the OAuth token refresh. Wrapped the refresh call in a retry so it tolerates the race. The fix landed in commit abc1234. Follow-up: audit other call sites for the same race condition.
expected_output: A new journal entry under .journals/<date>/<date>_<topic>_<title>/<date>_<topic>_<title>.md with valid frontmatter (created_at, updated_at, title, topic, brief), a body that preserves the auth_test.py fix and the follow-up, and the journal index regenerated afterwards.
assertions: A file matching the pattern .journals/<date>/<date>_<topic-slug>_<title-slug>/<date>_<topic-slug>_<title-slug>.md was created
The file's frontmatter contains all five required fields: created_at, updated_at, title, topic, and brief
created_at and updated_at are valid ISO-8601 timestamps
topic is lowercase kebab-case (only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens)
The entry body preserves the substantive context: the auth_test.py fix, the OAuth token-refresh retry, and the follow-up to audit other call sites
update_journal_index.py was run after writing the entry (.journals/index.md exists and references the new entry), or the transcript shows the script being invoked
